rationale: I read the complete held EO 13555 (75 FR 65417, signed October 19, 2010, White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics): it sets the policy, establishes the Initiative in the Department of Education and the President's Advisory Commission on Educational Excellence for Hispanics, and in sec. 4(a) supersedes EO 13230. It has no own term for the order as a whole. I read the held full text of EO 13935 (85 FR 42683, signed July 9, 2020, White House Hispanic Prosperity Initiative): sec. 4(a) provides 'This order supersedes Executive Order 13555 of October 19, 2010 (White House Initiative on Educational Excellence for Hispanics), and section 1(u) of Executive Order 13889 of September 27, 2019 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees).' That names EO 13555 by number, date and title and supersedes all of it; sec. 4(b) to (d) are general provisions, not savings of EO 13555. D6 self-check: the intervening events are continuances of the Commission, not ends: EO 13634 (December 21, 2012) re-established the Commission 'as set forth under the provisions of Executive Order 13555' to September 30, 2013; EO 13652 (2013), EO 13708 (2015), EO 13811 (2017) and EO 13889 sec. 1(u) (2019) list it as continued. EO 13935 supersedes both EO 13555 and the 13889 continuance. A search of the held full-run texts for '13555' finds only these orders and a page-number hit in the unrelated EO 9651 contents column; no held later instrument names or restores EO 13555. The OFR note 'Supersedes: EO 13555, October 19, 2010' on EO 13935 agrees. The single history observation (the API catalog record) was reviewed. Provisional NO hypothesis; the effective end (signing July 9, 2020, no later effective date stated) is not otherwise adjudicated.
